oracleRisk.summary: The tracked deprecated V1 uses collateral pricing only when recording a mint. Its verified router later burns the exact recorded ZeUSD debt and returns the recorded collateral, with no ongoing collateral-health oracle or liquidation engine.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: The tracked ZeUSD V1 router records collateral value and ZeUSD debt at mint, then requires the recorded debt to be burned before returning the recorded collateral. That mint/redemption valuation is a price-sensitive top-level authority even though V1 has no continuing health check or forced-liquidation branch; Zoth's separately deployed V2 is outside this record. The disposition is therefore top-level-only.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: ZeUSD is issued only on Ethereum as a standard upgradeable ERC20 and bridged via a LayerZero OFT Adapter (lockbox) at 0xBf1060028b212896F799CFbaeA1eD4EEbd060978, which locks canonical ZeUSD on Ethereum (LayerZero Endpoint V2) and mints "ZeUSD OFT" representations on Manta, Metis, and Avalanche. The durable cross-chain supply path is a third-party LayerZero lock/mint Adapter, not an issuer-controlled or DVN-reviewed network.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Pharos bridge-route re-verification; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-6 (lead usde-ethena)

protocols.name: LayerZero OFT Adapter (Zoth contract deployments)
protocols.note: Zoth docs explicitly list a 'Layer Zero Adapter' on Ethereum (0xBf1060028b212896F799CFbaeA1eD4EEbd060978) and 'ZeUSD OFT' contracts on Manta/Metis/Avalanche; marked as deprecated infrastructure but the documented cross-chain route.

protocols.name: LayerZero OFTAdapter contract (Etherscan)
protocols.note: Inherits OFTAdapter/OFTCore/IOAppCore, references LayerZero Endpoint V2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c, wraps inner ZeUSD via token(); send/quoteSend/lzReceive/setPeer present. Lock-on-Ethereum, mint-on-satellite pattern.

protocols.name: ZeUSD token (plain upgradeable ERC20, not an OFT)
protocols.note: ERC1967 proxy over an ERC20Upgradeable/AccessControl/UUPS impl with no LayerZero/OFT messaging functions — confirms the Adapter/lockbox (not native OFT) architecture.
